hypothesis: FCLR-H001: funding + price features improve 24h realized-variance (mean log-RV QLIKE) forecasts beyond an RV-only HAR baseline.
splits: 60/20/20 by unique UTC timestamp; 7-day (168h) purge/embargo at train/val and val/test boundaries; test -> 3 interleaved blocks

models.B1: OLS HAR on log RV1h/RV24h/RV168h -> log next-24h RV

primary_contrast: C2 vs B1 on paired next-24h QLIKE
inference: >=2000 deterministic moving-block bootstrap replicates (block=24 rows, seed=20261126); report absolute/relative QLIKE, 95% CI, per-block, leave-one-symbol-out
decision_rule: PROMOTED iff relative QLIKE reduction >=2% AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0; else NOT_SUPPORTED; INCONCLUSIVE if test data insufficient
